title: Meshtastic US community preset
description: One Meshtastic community in the United States. 'published' entries carry radio settings the community itself has published at a public URL. 'listed' entries only say the community exists and where to ask; they carry no radio settings.

id.description: Path of this file without .json, e.g. us/ca/baymesh. Must match the file's location.

state.description: Two-letter USPS code, upper case. Multi-state groups get one file under the state they are best known for and name the rest in 'area'.

area.description: Plain-language coverage: cities, counties or region.

status.description: published = settings below come from the community's own public page. listed = no public settings found; ask the community.

sources.description: Public URLs the entry was taken from. For 'published', the page(s) that state the settings.

checked.description: Date (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD) a person or the monthly check last compared this file with its sources.

contact.description: Where a newcomer should go to reach the community.

modemPresetNum.description: ModemPreset number from meshtastic/protobufs (LONG_FAST=0, MEDIUM_FAST=4, LONG_TURBO=9, MEDIUM_TURBO=16). Checked against schema/enums.json.

frequencySlot.description: LoRa channel_num (the app's 'Frequency Slot'). null = the community does not publish one; leave the radio on 0 (automatic).

frequencyMHz.description: Centre frequency, only if the community states it.

primaryChannel.description: Primary channel, if the community states it. Omitted means not stated. The stock public channel is name "" and psk "AQ==".

psk.description: Base64. Only keys the community publishes openly.

minFirmware.description: Lowest firmware the settings need, if stated (e.g. 2.7.17 for LONG_TURBO).

uses.description: Per-use settings. 'default' applies to any radio; the other keys override it for that use. Leave out anything the community does not publish.

home.description: Fixed node at home: attic, window, rooftop.

extra.description: A second radio close to another of the owner's nodes.

okToMqtt.description: What the community asks for LoRa 'OK to MQTT'. Omit if they say nothing.

advice.description: One or two sentences, in plain language, of what the community says about MQTT.

else.description: Listed entries must not carry radio settings.

roleNum.description: Role number from meshtastic/protobufs (CLIENT=0, CLIENT_MUTE=1, CLIENT_BASE=12). Checked against schema/enums.json.
